scripts.dev: npm run build -w @game/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @game/shared" "npm run dev -w @game/server" "npm run dev -w @game/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run build -w @game/server && npm run build -w @game/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @game/shared && tsx --test tests/movement.test.ts tests/bell.test.ts tests/bell-network.test.ts
